Node 0 asks 3 peers for any slot from 1 it may have missed. It does not claim to be behind. A decision reaches a follower only as a commit watermark. A watermark that it did not receive looks the same as a watermark that was never set.

A matchmaker quorum has answered node 0. The union of their histories, above the watermark 2.0, names 1 earlier configuration: {0, 1, 2}. Phase 1 may open now, and not before. The matchmakers prove that no earlier ballot chose a value this candidate cannot see.

steps.label: node 0 crashes

stage.title: Matchmakers · ballot 3.1
stage.about: The new leader writes down which acceptors its ballot uses, and it learns which acceptors the older ballots used.

steps.says: Node 0 crashes. The disk of Node 0 keeps its promise and its votes. It forgets the rest.
notes: Node 0 crashes. Its disk keeps promise 2.0 and 1 accepted record. Its role, its open rounds, its read rounds and its election timer are gone. Leadership is entirely volatile here, so a crash *is* an abdication and needs no durable fence. Nobody re-sends the Phase-2 rounds that were lost with it.

steps.says: Node 1 starts an election. Node 1 wants to lead at ballot 3.1. It starts Phase 1.

Node 1 becomes a candidate at ballot 3.1: it wants the whole log suffix.
Node 1 raises its durable promise from 2.0 to 3.1. The promise is durable before anything leaves.
